== Checklist == {{CheckboxList}} *[[Brain of the Ishva Mal]] *[[Fire Beetle Eye]] *[[Griffon Eye]] *[[Ice Giant Toes]] *[[Powder of Reanimation]] {{End}} == Walkthrough == ''[[Nivold Predd]] can be found inside the Tabernacle of Terror in [[Paineel]] at (1116, 518).'' You say, 'Hail, Nivold Predd' : Nivold Predd says, 'What do you want? Do not disturb me lest you plan to assist in my [Summoning of Dread].' You say, 'I will assist in the summoning of Dread.' : Nivold Predd says, 'There are some components essential to the summoning of the avatar of Dread. I require the eye of a griffon, some [powder of reanimation], the brain of the Ishva Mal, and the toes of an ice giant. Fetch me these reagents so that we may summon the avatar to forge a shield worn only by the mightiest apostles of Cazic-Thule.' You say, 'What is powder of reanimation?' : Nivold Predd says, 'There is a gnome necromancer who has been experimenting with a powder used in reanimating long dead organic tissue. He is known to frequent places populated by undead in order to pursue his research. Seek him out and procure a bit of his powder.' '''Travel to [[Unrest]] and locate [[Khrix Fritchoff]] on the second floor (595, 61).''' You say, 'Hail, Khrix Fritchoff' : Khrix Fritchoff says 'Close the door and be gone, fool!! You are going to give away my hiding spot!!' You say, 'I require a powder of reanimation' : Khrix Fritchoff says, 'So you want the powder of reanimation eh? Well you can have it if you can get it from that terrible abomination I have created! Perhaps you have a Fire Beetle Eye for me so that I may see my way out of here! '''Give him a [[Fire Beetle Eye]] (He will accept at dubious) and A [[Khrix Abomination]] will spawn in the room directly behind Khrix's closet (not in it). It is very powerful maybe 35-40.''' : Khrix Fritchoff says 'At last I may leave this place!! Good luck destroying my abomination, you will surely need it against my most powerful yet uncontrollable creation!'
* Your faction standing with [[Dark Reflection]] got better. * Your faction standing with [[Eldritch Collective]] got worse. * Your faction standing with [[Gem Choppers]] got worse.
{{YouGainExperience}} : Khrix Abomination says, 'Grrrarrrrrg!! Har har grrrarrrrg!!' '''Kill the Khrix Abomination and loot [[Powder of Reanimation]]. Return to [[Paineel]] and hand in the Powder of Reanimation, [[Griffon Eye]], [[Ice Giant Toes]], and the [[Brain of the Ishva Mal]] to [[Nivold Predd]].''' : Nivold Predd says, 'Commendable work, you have proven yourself a valuable member of our order. Our chanters have summoned the avatar of Dread. Hurry and take him this mundane shield so that he may forge it into a truly valuable symbol of your devotion to the lord of Fear!'
* Your faction standing with [[Heretics]] got better. * Your faction standing with [[Deepwater Knights]] got worse. * Your faction standing with [[Gate Callers]] got worse. * Your faction standing with [[Craftkeepers]] got worse. * Your faction standing with [[Crimson Hands]] got worse.
{{YouGainExperience}} You receive 6 platinum from Nivold Predd. ''You receive a [[Mundane Shield]]. An [[Avatar of Dread]] spawns in a nearby room.'' Avatar of dread shouts 'Grrrraaaaarrrrrg!! The stench of fear permeates the walls of this city! I will forge one item for the faithful of our Lord Cazic-Thule!! Make haste! My time here is short!' [[File:npc_avatar_of_dread.png|frame|Avatar of Dread]] '''Give the Mundane Shield to the Avatar of Dread.''' : Avatar of Dread says, 'Wear this shield imbued with my very essence. Wear it in honor of your great services to our Lord Cazic-Thule!!'
* Your faction standing with [[Heretics]] got better. * Your faction standing with [[Deepwater Knights]] got worse. * Your faction standing with [[Gate Callers]] got worse. * Your faction standing with [[Craftkeepers]] got worse. * Your faction standing with [[Crimson Hands]] got worse.
{{YouGainExperience}} You receive [[Dread Forged Shield]]. == Notes ==
